description: Returns the payment terms for https://horizonpulse.dev/api/treasury/debt (base $0.01; USDC on Base or Polygon); this tool never runs the check or pays. Pay the 402 over HTTP with x402 v2: GET with no parameters. U.S. Treasury debt to the penny: total, held by the public, and intragovernmental, with the 1-day, 30-day and 1-year change, plus the Daily Treasury Statement Treasury General Account (TGA) operating-cash balance and its daily change. No parameters. Source: api.fiscaldata.treasury.gov. debtUsd is USD. cashUsdMillions is millions of USD. Not a forecast. USDC on Base or Polygon. On USDC on Base, errors are not charged, apart from the exceptions noted on a route. On USDC on Solana, and RLUSD on the XRP Ledger, a refused or failed request may still be charged. On Polygon (native USDC), a request is settled only when it succeeds (HTTP status below 400). Failed requests are not charged.
